segments.name: Customer Acquisition
segments.description: Operates a technology platform connecting insurance carriers and distributors with high-intent consumers to buy and sell Consumer Referrals.
segments.evidence: We generate revenue by earning a fee for each Consumer Referral sold on our platform.

revenueModel.text: Insurance carriers and distributors pay a fee for each Consumer Referral sold to them on the platform.
revenueModel.evidence: A buyer or a Demand Partner within our ecosystem is generally an insurance carrier, agent or distributor seeking to reach high-intent insurance consumers.

changes.text: In 2025 the company significantly scaled back its health business serving consumers below the Medicare age.
changes.evidence: we have scaled back our business in under-65 health significantly
